name: availability_exception
description: Private one-date tutor availability exception in the tutor's local time zone

user_id.description: Buildy user id of the owning tutor

date_local.description: Single calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form, interpreted in the tutor's time zone

kind.description: Whether the tutor is off or has an extra teaching window

start_local.description: Local start clock time for an extra window, empty for off

end_local.description: Local end clock time for an extra window, empty for off

time_zone.description: Tutor's IANA time zone for this local date
